system.description:
Size Medium • Speed 30ft • Darkvision 60ft • +2 Wis / +1 Cha, −1 Str

Traits

  • Resistance 5 to necrotic & radiant. At will: bright light 10ft radius (illumination only).
  • Celestial Wings (1st): wings of light let you glide. You take no damage from falls, and move 2ft sideways for every 1ft you drop. From 3rd level your wings carry you: you have a fly speed equal to your walking speed.
  • Ascension (5th): once per day, your fly speed doubles for the encounter (1 Luck for a second use).
  • Flight: you can't fly in medium or heavy armour or while over your carrying limit; from 9th level you can fly in any armour you are trained in (still not over your carrying limit). You fall if you are knocked Prone, Stunned, Paralysed or Unconscious in the air (see Falling Damage in The Arneyan Codex).
  • Advantage on saves vs frightened.
  • Choose one Wisdom or Charisma skill at creation; you have Advantage on checks with it. This is not a Proficiency tier and does not take an NWP slot.
